theme_and_archetype.description: A professional, trustworthy, and calm aesthetic designed for school administrators, teachers, and parents. Avoids standard SaaS blue/purple gradients. Uses grounded, matte, and physical tones to reduce visual fatigue during dense data entry and analytics tasks.

headings.weight_strategy: Use font-medium (500) to font-semibold (600) for elegance. Avoid overly heavy blacks.

layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white border border-[#E6E1D6] rounded-lg shadow-none transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-sm hover:border-[#D5CFC1]
layout_and_spacing.density: Control Room strategy for dashboards: efficient use of space with tight gap-4 or gap-6. Generous spacing (py-16) for parent portal and login pages.

surface_strategies.header: Solid surface #FFFFFF with a crisp 1px bottom border #E6E1D6. No glassmorphism in the main admin dashboard to keep data clear.
surface_strategies.sidebar: Background #F9F8F6, active items in #E6EADF with primary text #4E5B3A. Subtle 1px right border #E6E1D6.
surface_strategies.tables: Flat white background, crisp 1px borders on rows. Sticky headers with subtle background #F2EFEB.
surface_strategies.login_page: Split screen layout: Left side clean form on #FFFFFF, right side hero abstract image (hero_abstract_bg) covering full height.

component_rules.buttons: Solid primary colors. No generic gradients. Focus states must have ring-2 ring-primary/30 ring-offset-2.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn default with border-[#E6E1D6] focus:border-[#4E5B3A] focus:ring-[#4E5B3A]/20.
component_rules.badges: Soft backgrounds (status_bg) with dark text (status). No harsh neon colors.
component_rules.charts: Recharts with customized tooltips (white background, border, subtle shadow). Use the chart_palette colors.
component_rules.tabs: Underline style preferred over pill style for a more mature, academic look.
component_rules.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (regular or light weight) for a consistent, professional, non-generic look. Fallback to lucide-react if Phosphor is unavailable.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle transform -translate-y-[1px] on interactive cards. Color darkening on buttons.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use Skeleton loaders (Shadcn) with a warm subtle pulse (#F2EFEB to #E6E1D6) rather than cold gray.

image_urls.description: Abstract earthy geometric background, sage green and terracotta shapes, matte texture, minimal, calming, soft lighting. Used for login page background or marketing hero.
Modern school hallway interior, sunlight coming through large windows. Good for parent portal banners or about sections.
Close up of an open textbook with soft morning light, wooden desk, reading glasses. Good for syllabus or academic sections.
White concrete building near green trees. Use for Platform Admin school listing thumbnails.
Student studying. Use as a fallback for student profile pictures.
Minimalist logo placeholder for school logos.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: All files must be .js or .jsx. Do NOT use .tsx.
CRITICAL: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements, buttons, links, and forms. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
CRITICAL: Apply the custom colors as Tailwind config variables (e.g., colors: { primary: { DEFAULT: '#4E5B3A', hover: '#3A452B' } }).
CRITICAL: Use Outfit for all headings and Manrope for body text. Add them to index.css and Tailwind config.
Do NOT use default Shadcn border radius. Set radius to 0.5rem (rounded-lg) in global CSS.
Avoid overusing the Shadcn Card component if it leads to excessive nesting. Use semantic HTML (section, div) with border and bg-white for cleaner DOM.
Do not use generic blue/purple gradients. Adhere strictly to the Organic & Earthy palette.
Ensure tenant isolation logic is visually clear (e.g., displaying the current school name prominently in the Topbar for School Admin/Teachers).
For the Parent Portal, use a slightly softer and wider layout compared to the data-dense Admin dashboards.
Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios against the background colors.
